findings.description: The unobstructed opening bowl contains 8 balls, including 2 red. After the child reaches into it and lifts a red ball, sharp frames from 1.00 to 2.00 seconds show the same 8 balls still in the bowl plus the held red ball: 9 total, including 3 red. No extra ball is visibly introduced. The child is handling and subsequently stirring the balls; no deliberate multiplication performance is visually established.

The additional red ball is lowered into the bowl at 2.25 seconds. After the hand exposes the return area around 5.125–5.25 seconds, the bowl again shows only 2 red, 3 green and 3 yellow balls, rather than the 9 previously accounted for. No ball visibly leaves the bowl or is carried away; the decrease is assessed after the return-area occlusion clears.
